nonce: opId=u64LE||zero24; H3 actor scoped; H4 exact original frame; latest-only replay
indexRule: public prefix8; normalized prefix7 removes BaseConfig. normalized suffix index>=7 maps +1; INIT public suffix Mint/Reserve/Auth/Treasury/Program/ProgramData with prefix Base then private normalized Base moved behind Treasury

operations.name: CREATE_PROJECT
operations.dynamicAccounts: Append unique wallet table sorted by raw pubkey for non-prefix seller, feePayer, rentPayer. Payload roles define native signatures; alias to actor uses actor once. Name length u32@144 must1..64 and payload=216+nameLen.

operations.name: BUY_MATERIAL
operations.dynamicAccounts: Append unique wallet table sorted raw pubkey for non-prefix payer/recipient/seller/rentPayer. Quantity1..1000; payer/rentPayer signatures, passive recipient/seller no implicit signature. Destination mode exact0/1.

operations.name: QUEUE_OPS
operations.dynamicAccounts: Append unique wallet roles recipient/rentPayer sorted raw pubkey, skip actor. Actor must one approved Ops member.

operations.name: PAY_OPS
operations.dynamicAccounts: Append unique wallet table recipient/rentPayer/three selected Ops sorted raw pubkey, skip actor. Selected indices@160..163 strictly ascending, exactly3 native signatures.

operations.name: ARTIFACT_PUT
operations.constraints: payload=60+chunkLen. chunkLen1..1024; offset canonical written, non-final chunks exactly1024. Append-only shared Artifact. Initial chunk allocates, sealed content immutable.

operations.name: MANUFACTURE_PART
operations.dynamicAccounts: From sealed MaterialPlan: sorted unique projectId Project[w] list; sorted unique (projectId,class) Mint[w] list; TokenSource[w] per canonical Intake order; sorted unique union(existing debit sourceId,new intake sourceId) Source[w] list (<=32); then unique raw-pubkey sorted wallet role table (rentPayer/intake owners) excluding actor. Intake owners native signer; rentPayer native signer. Project is writable to track actual material burns. component::make exact table indices9+.

operations.name: VERIFY_BEGIN
operations.dynamicAccounts: Append Direct Root[r] in exact payload Direct order; target determines4/2..4/6 accounts. No client-q.

operations.name: VERIFY_STEP
operations.dynamicAccounts: Phase0 only append current DirectRoot[r],its actual source Artifact[r]; other phases no suffix. State controls phase/work count.

operations.name: SYNTH_FINALIZE
operations.dynamicAccounts: Only lengths124(mode0) or189(mode1 with byte124=1). Append n DirectRoot[w], n corresponding RootReg[w] in canonical Direct order; append Task/Round/Disclosure; q2 BIO add Knowledge/KSlot; existing K adds actual Act/RR/Position/Root and potential stopEvent dedup; mode1 then Snapshot[r]/Commit[w]/Candidate[w]. No other length.

operations.name: REGISTER_ORDINARY
operations.dynamicAccounts: If re-registering append previousPosition[r]. Then new ordinary START Event[w]. CurrentHour pointer binds exact Registry.nextHour; no arbitrary currentHour.

operations.name: EXIT_ORDINARY
operations.dynamicAccounts: If actual K OPEN append Task[w]/KSlot[w]/Activation[w]/KEndEvent[w]; OrdinaryEndEvent must queueIndex+1, KEndEvent queueIndex. Without K exactly fixed suffix. Both maxRent summed once.

operations.name: OPEN_HOUR
operations.constraints: Creates kind18/schema4 body362/record482 with lazy0; complete due Event frontier freezes exact member count, ordinary/K totals, same-root K identity and denominator. Old schema3 is read only by sequential settlement; it is never rewritten as schema4.

operations.name: APPLY_EVENT
operations.dynamicAccounts: Event kind0 append activeTail Directory[w] iff notMAX; kind1 append prev/next Directory[w] iff notMAX; kind2/3 append actual Activation[r]. No historical-root scan.

operations.name: EMPTY_SKIP
operations.constraints: none; expectedNextHour and targetExclusive are checked against the complete queue head and cached empty active/K state; CurrentHour must be canonical and fresh; no live hour or due event may be skipped.

operations.name: ADVANCE_FROZEN_HOUR
operations.constraints: hour:u64,maxRent:u64. Requires actual mature current READY/PARTIAL Hour kind18/schema4 (482 bytes), lazy0; marks lazy1 and advances only Registry freeze frontier. No Treasury/Token accounts or balance movement. Schema3 remains sequential-only.

operations.name: MATERIALIZE_HOUR
operations.dynamicAccounts: For nonempty Hour append exactly Directory[r]/RootReg[w]/Position[w]. Sequential mode binds frozen nextDirectory; schema4 lazy1 accepts any actual eligible historical Position and canonical Directory identity, independent of current active links. expectedCursor is always the Hour processed-count CAS. Empty Hour has no suffix. Position own nextUnsettled and RootReg.coverageSeq bind one award; beneficiary is immutable.

operations.name: CLOSE_FINAL_HOUR
operations.dynamicAccounts: Append saved originalPayer[w] iff different from actor; otherwise refund actor prefix0. Exact9/10 normalized accounts. Never refund cranker by choice.

operations.name: SEAL_OPENING
operations.dynamicAccounts: Append at most8 contiguous (Knowledge[r],Seed[r]) pairs, cursor/maxScan exact.

operations.name: FINALIZE_ROUND
operations.dynamicAccounts: Phase0 no suffix; BASELINE up to8 Knowledge[r] contiguous; CANDIDATES Candidate/Commit/Disclosure/ownKnowledge + full contiguous chunk excluding own alias; READY winner adds Candidate/Commit/ownKnowledge/NewWinner/Root/RootReg and, only actual-eligible, Position/NewActivation/KHistory/Registry/Event/oldActivation(if exists). Complete-source code defines each state. Round schema2 locks scanCount@381 on epoch reset; BASELINE/CANDIDATE scan entire0..scanCount, each accepted correction Knowledge(kind2) immediately followed by its authoritative Safety20/2[r] unless same account already present. Effective origin anchor filters old start/deadline prefixes; late ordinary entries are scanned but excluded. Safety body321/total441; Round body389/total509.

operations.name: ACTIVATE_WINNER
operations.dynamicAccounts: Append oldActivation[r] iff KSlot has historical ref. Start future hour only.

operations.name: PROVE_TASK_FAULT
operations.dynamicAccounts: Qualified PASS adds NewCorrectedKnowledge[w]/canonicalDisclosure[w]. Correction-kind target adds priorSafety[r] if not already present. Faulted realRoot adds realRR[w], and iff ordinary OPEN Position[w]/OrdEND[w]. Current K adds Act[w]/RR[w]/associatedPosition[r]/Root[r]/KEND[w], dedup previous accounts. UNKNOWN refuses, VM traps roll back. Safety schema2 appends immutable originKnowledgeIndex@313; same-H7 corrections inherit the actual validated earlier Safety origin only if an existing canonical H8 firstEvent is strictly before the old qualifiedEvent; fresh H8, changed H7 or later/equal disclosure anchors at the new correctedIndex. Actual times are not backdated.

operations.name: AUDIT_NEXT
operations.dynamicAccounts: If cursor<target append Knowledge[r]; INVALID adds referencedSafety[r] unless same currentSafety. Accepted adds Verification[r]/Artifact[r]/AcceptedBase[r]/canonicalDisclosure[r]; correction-kind adds priorSafety[r] iff different currentSafety. Cursor==target no suffix.
